scenarios.title: Asking a colleague for a report
scenarios.recipient: a colleague you work with every day

registers.informal: Hey, just wanted to see if you had that sales report from last week? Need it by Friday for the team meeting. Thanks!
registers.neutral: Hi Tom, I wanted to check whether you had the quarterly sales report. I need it by Friday for our team meeting. Could you forward it to me?
registers.formal: Dear Mr Kumar, I am writing to enquire whether the quarterly sales report is available. I would require it by Friday, 29th August, for the weekly team briefing. Would you be able to send it through at your earliest convenience?

registers.informal: Thanks so much for the invite! Unfortunately, I can't make it on Tuesday, but I hope it goes well. Is there a recording?
registers.neutral: Thank you for the invitation. Unfortunately, I won't be able to attend on Tuesday due to a prior commitment. Would a recording be available for me to review?
registers.formal: Dear Dr Patel, Thank you for your invitation to the research seminar on 17th September. Unfortunately, I have a conflicting engagement and must respectfully decline. Should the proceedings be recorded, I would be most grateful to review them at a later date.

registers.informal: Hey, just checking in on that invoice #5847 from 15th July. Still waiting on it—can you let me know what's happening?
registers.neutral: Good morning, I am following up regarding invoice #5847 from 15th July, which remains outstanding. Could you please confirm receipt and provide an expected payment date?
registers.formal: Dear Ms Zhang, We respectfully write to follow up on invoice reference #5847, issued 15th July 2026, which regrettably remains unsettled. We would appreciate your urgent attention to this matter and respectfully request payment within the next five working days.
